workbench_agents_add_project: Button of the empty Agents view when no project exists yet
workbench_agents_all_projects: Agents view filter option: every project
workbench_agents_all_states: Agents view filter option: every agent state
workbench_agents_choose_worktree: Button of the empty Agents view when no worktree is selected
workbench_agents_clear_filters: Button of the empty Agents view when the filters match nothing

workbench_agents_column_done.description: Dashboard column of agents that finished
workbench_agents_column_done.distinct: an agent state heading, not the Done button

workbench_agents_column_idle.description: Dashboard column of agents that wait for work
workbench_agents_column_idle.distinct: a column heading in sentence case, not the lowercase state word

workbench_agents_empty_filtered: Empty Agents view description when the filters match nothing
workbench_agents_empty_no_activity_here: Empty Agents view description for a selected worktree with no agent activity
workbench_agents_empty_no_project: Empty Agents view description when no project exists
workbench_agents_empty_no_worktree: Empty Agents view description when no worktree is selected
workbench_agents_feed_no_match: Empty feed title when a filter is active
workbench_agents_feed_none: Empty feed title with no filter
workbench_agents_in_state: Dashboard card: how long the agent has been in its current state (age is like 5m)
workbench_agents_new_session: Button of the empty Agents view that starts an agent; a shortcut follows it
workbench_agents_summary: Agents view header: how many agents work out of how many exist
